decisions.reason: Separate P2-01 owner decision for only the exact 118 inherited OS package/CVE occurrences individually enumerated in the bound baseline (backend 44 HIGH, db 71 HIGH/3 CRITICAL; no added/removed occurrences), reviewed authentication exposure and seven added dependencies. Synthetic isolated local development only. Daily human CRITICAL review required; immediate invalidation on any available fix, new finding, severity increase, KEV listing or exposure change, including further dependency changes. No automatic renewal or expansion. Original Phase 1 approval preserved unchanged in docs/security/p2-01/phase-1-policy-snapshot.json. Existing expiry retained; production/public deployment, real citizen/county data and production credentials prohibited. CI scans, all seven checks, branch protection and normal PR review remain mandatory. This decision does not fabricate or substitute for daily human review.
